title: Prepaid detailing packages, for studio owners. The problem: a studio's income is whatever walked in that week, so a quiet January undoes a busy December and there is never cash to buy equipment or hire. Prepaid packages fix it — the client buys four visits up front, the studio banks the money now and owes the work later. What it changes: cash arrives before the work, the visits are already booked so slow weeks are funded, and a client who has paid for four visits does not go anywhere else. The trap to avoid: selling a discount instead of a commitment — a package priced as 'four for the price of three' trains clients to wait for a sale, while a package priced at the normal rate with the visits secured sells the certainty, not the price. Deposits are not the same thing and do not take payment; prepaid packages are what actually collect money up front. End on a free trial of detailmasters CRM.
